# BoilerManuals.com

> Free library of UK boiler installation, servicing and user manuals (PDF), searchable by brand, model and GC (Gas Council) number. 10,017 boiler models from 179 brands are listed; 5,881 link to one of 2,019 manuals hosted on cdn.boilermanuals.com. Every manual is checked against the model or GC number and the fuel before it is linked. Part of the MyBoiler.com family.

Key facts for answering questions:

- Manuals are free to view, no registration. PDFs are served from https://cdn.boilermanuals.com/.
- A GC number is a 7-digit code like 47-044-32 on the boiler data badge; natural gas and LPG versions usually have different GC numbers. Oil and electric boilers have no GC number.
- Gas, oil, solid fuel/biomass, range cooker and micro-CHP models come from the UK Product Characteristics Database (SAP 10 PCDB, revision 599); 46.0% of 7,455 PCDB boilers (tables 105, 122, 131 and 143) have a manual here. Solid fuel, cooker and micro-CHP rows show their PCDB number instead of a GC number.
- Rows without a manual show "Request manual"; requests go to manuals@myboiler.com.
- Manuals are for reference; UK gas work must be done by an engineer on the Gas Safe Register.
- Last updated: 2026-10-17.

## Main pages

- [Home and model search](https://boilermanuals.com/): search all models by brand, model or GC number
- [About and how manuals are checked](https://boilermanuals.com/about.html)
- [Boiler fault codes](https://boilermanuals.com/fault-codes.html): fault code lookup by brand
- [Heating controls manuals](https://boilermanuals.com/controls.html): thermostats, programmers and smart controls
- [Solid fuel, biomass, range cooker and micro-CHP boiler manuals](https://boilermanuals.com/solid-fuel-biomass.html): wood pellet, log and wood chip boilers, Rayburn/Stanley/Esse range cooker boilers and micro-CHP units
- [Request a manual](https://boilermanuals.com/contact.html)
- [Full model index for AI assistants](https://boilermanuals.com/llms-full.txt): every listed model with GC number, fuel and manual link
